title: Reviewing AI-Generated Code
description: Reading AI output for correctness, security, and maintainability — the skill that matters more than typing speed once AI writes the first draft.

title: The Bugs AI Writes Most
description: Recognise the recurring defect patterns in generated code — off-by-one boundaries, copy-paste symmetry errors, plausible-but-wrong defaults, and happy-path-only logic — and know why the training data produces them at this specific rate.

title: Injection and Untrusted Input
description: Find every place untrusted input reaches an interpreter — SQL, a shell, a browser's DOM, a model with tools — and close it with the fix that actually removes the channel, not the one that just makes it harder to hit.

title: Auth, Secrets and Permissions
description: Check that generated code enforces who may do what, not just who's logged in, and that nothing secret is sitting in source, logs, error messages, or a bundle shipped to every browser.

title: Concurrency, Time and Ordering
description: Find the assumptions about ordering and simultaneity that generated code makes without saying so — two requests racing on the same row, a retry that isn't safe to repeat, a date that's off by a day, an await that was never written, a transaction that covers less than it looks like it covers.

title: Error Handling and Failure Paths
description: Judge whether generated code fails in a way anyone can diagnose, or fails silently and expensively — the swallowed exception, the error with nothing a caller can act on, the half-finished write nobody rolls back, and the retry that turns a blip into an outage.
